judged_text: In sharing mode refreshOAuthTokens returns the raw fetch Response while its fallback branch returns the provider-specific shape (googleapis result, axios response, parsed SDK object), so callers that unwrap the result themselves break when credential sharing is enabled. With APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT set, googlecalendar's `const token = res?.data` yields undefined and `token.access_token` throws TypeError, zoho-bigin/zohocrm's `tokenInfo.data.error` throws TypeError on the Response object, and hubspot reads undefined fields off the Response (NaN expiry, undefined tokens persisted) — token refresh for those integrations fails or corrupts stored credentials on every attempt.

With APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT set, googlecalendar's `const token = res?.data` yields undefined and `token.access_token` throws TypeError, zoho-bigin/zohocrm's `tokenInfo.data.error` throws TypeError on the Response object, and hubspot reads undefined fields off the Response (NaN expiry, undefined tokens persisted) — token refresh for those integrations fails or corrupts stored credentials on every attempt.

adjudication.rationale: In the new `refreshOAuthTokens` helper (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts), the “sharing mode” branch returns a raw `fetch()` `Response` (`return response;`), while the fallback branch returns whatever the provider refresh function returns (googleapis `.res`, axios response object, HubSpot SDK token object, etc.). The callers in this diff continue to treat the returned value as provider-shaped: e.g. Google Calendar does `const token = res?.data;` (expects axios/googleapis-style `.data`) but in sharing mode `res` is a `Response` with no `.data`, so `token` becomes undefined and `token.access_token` will throw. Similarly, Zoho Bigin/Zoho CRM check `tokenInfo.data.error` after wrapping with `refreshOAuthTokens`, which will also break when `tokenInfo` is a `Response`. HubSpot assigns the return value to `HubspotToken` and later reads fields from it; a `Response` won’t have those fields. This mismatch is directly introduced by the helper and its new usages shown in the diff.
